name: The Dawn of Lily
source:
A cute fox girl has arrived to the earth, with the mission of making the world a more happy place... using a MyTuber? (Youtuber parody). Can love grow between the two of them?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190705092057/https://gamejolt.com/games/thedawnoflily/183853]Game Jolt[/url]]
translation:
一位可爱的狐狸女孩来到了地球，她的使命是让世界变得更加幸福……使用MyTuber？（YouTuber模仿）。两人之间能否产生爱情呢？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190705092057/https://gamejolt.com/games/thedawnoflily/183853]游戏Jolt[/url]]
